officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară (ANCPI)
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: national public viewer for registered immovables and buildings
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official viewer documentation says data comes from the ANCPI geospatial database, is updated daily, and exposes parcel/building limits at appropriate scale; search is by address, county/UAT/carte funciară, or geographic position. It is a viewer, not proof of a stable anonymous vector endpoint.

Indexed ArcGIS metadata identifies a polygon Feature Layer named Cadastral Parcel, supports JSON/GeoJSON and queries, uses EPSG:4258, and has a Romania-scale extent. The live host timed out during this attempt, so no Iași feature was accepted.

Official page loaded and publishes 2026 agricultural land-sale/pre-emption notices with cadastral numbers for Municipiul Iași. It establishes a local cadastral custodian/publication route, not open parcel geometry coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Local Iași municipal cadastral publication and national Romanian cadastral viewer/INSPIRE layer are evidenced; no anonymous citywide parcel geometry scope was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: The official national Cadastral Parcel service timed out before metadata or geometry could be read live, and ANCPI/OCPI hosts had local DNS failures. The municipal GIS page is a publication/notice service without a verified public vector response. No safe anonymous Iași parcel ID-plus-geometry response was established.
remainingUncertainty: The indexed national layer metadata indicates a Romania-scale polygon service and the ANCPI viewer may show registered immovables, but route availability, Iași coverage, field schema and current geometry could not be verified in this attempt. A zero exact-point hit was not used as an absence claim.
nextStep: Retry the official Geoportal/ANCPI services when reachable; inspect only public geometry-plus-ID responses and confirm CRS and Iași coverage before any adapter qualification.
